rule: Books are independent resource reservoirs behind each Topic Arena. The student is never asked to read all three; the supervisor selects the smallest useful section for the current concept and mastery target.

books.title: Chemistry 2e
books.authors: Paul Flowers, Klaus Theopold, Richard Langley, William R. Robinson
books.why: Free, section-addressable and legally reusable for noncommercial adaptation with attribution. Best source for direct student links, concise reading slices and site-visible references.
books.ai_note: Do not bulk-ingest the book into an LLM; use section links and human-curated mappings.

books.title: Chemistry: A Molecular Approach
books.author: Nivaldo J. Tro
books.why: Strongest visual bridge between macroscopic, molecular and symbolic chemistry, with a consistent Sort → Strategize → Solve → Check problem-solving routine. Use when a concept is hard to picture or a worked-example strategy is needed.

books.title: Chemistry: The Central Science
books.authors: Theodore E. Brown, H. Eugene LeMay, Bruce E. Bursten, Catherine Murphy, Patrick Woodward, Matthew E. Stoltzfus
books.why: Use primarily to mine representative problem families, self-assessment prompts and alternative worked strategies after the concept is understood. This book is the depth/reference reservoir rather than the student's first reading.
